title: photo_flag
description: Contracts v1.15, decision 20261011-0310-hem-photo-flags: the answer to POST /sites/{id}/photos/{photo}/flags, a resident's report that a site photo is unrelated, private, a duplicate or offensive. Never carries who reported it or their description: the notes table keeps only a hash of the user id and of the device.

photo_id.description: The report id of the photo, the file name of its photo_urls key.

reason.description: unrelated: not this site or not waste. person_or_property: shows a person or private property. duplicate: the same photo again. offensive.

text_status.description: none without a description. shown: note moderation passed it; it feeds the site's community analysis as a neutral signal and is never shown or quoted. hidden: moderation removed it (toxic or personal data) or could not check it, and its text is not stored. The report counts either way.

moderation.description: Same shape and rules as site_note.moderation (Bedrock only); null without a description.

photo.description: The photo's entry in site.photo_flags after this report.

site_status.description: site.status after this report; removed (removed_reason photos_reported) when it hid the last photo of an unverified site.

created_at.description: When this person's latest report of the photo was recorded.
